extraction.text:
Anil Rokade

Senior Financial Analyst

+91- 8766926059 | anilarokade99@gmail.com | Pune, INDIA | Experience: 8 Years

Profile summary

With 8 years of experience as a Senior Financial Analyst, I specialize in pricing analysis, reconciliation, corporate actions and fund accounting across capital markets and investment banking processes. Proficient with Bloomberg, Canoe and related tools, I have a strong track record in valuation, P&L commentary, break analysis and investor reporting. I have driven process improvements through automation, delivered accurate investor documents, and trained teams to maintain high operational standards. Seeking finance roles across India in pricing, fund accounting and capital markets.

Skills: Pricing Analysis, Reconciliation, Corporate Actions, Bloomberg, Canoe, Reuters, ICE, Fund Accounting, NAV Calculation, Hedge Funds, Private Equity Fund, P&L Reporting, Break Analysis, Client Interaction, Team Handling

Work experience

Senior Financial Analyst – SG Analytics

Present

Preparing notices based on calculation sheet provided by FA team for capital

call/drawdowns, distributions notices for respective investors.

Documents like capital account statements, financial statements and other legal

documents provided to investors.

Preparing management fee call notices based on management fee calculation file received

from FA and authorized by our onshore team.

Additionally involved in processing payment invoices, reconciling trackers with bank

statements and managing documents sign reporting.

Document sign reporting like LPA, subscription documents.

Performed daily and monthly NAV calculations for hedge funds, mutual funds, and private investment funds.

Reconciled cash, positions, and transactions between internal records, custodians, brokers, and fund administrators.

Calculated fund expenses, management fees, performance fees, and accruals in accordance with fund agreements.

Prepared investor reports, financial statements, and fund performance reports for internal and external stakeholders.

Collaborated with portfolio managers, custodians, auditors, and clients to resolve operational and accounting issues.

Specialist – Statestreet HCL

Apr 2021 - Jun 2023

Executed security valuations and pricing (CUSIP/SEDOL/ISIN) using Bloomberg Terminal and other tools.

Interacting with Reuters, Bloomberg, IDC and other vendors for pricing related queries.

Doing stale and non-priced analysis for the securities getting stale more than week.

Improved risk mitigation and process efficiency through automation initiatives.

Resolving pricing / valuation queries raised by fund accountant and clients.

Provided training and development to team members to enhance capability.

Managed corporate actions and resolved discrepancies to support fund accounting and capital market processes.

2021

Oversaw daily trades, position and cash reconciliations for AXA IM Fund Managers.

Identified portfolio discrepancies and ensured timely resolution.

Produced daily and monthly P&L calculations and detailed commentaries on profit and loss movements.

Prepared and distributed communication reports to maintain operational accuracy.

Performed break analysis and prepared communication reports for fund managers on a daily basis.

Maintained inventory of breaks and position status and communicated required corrective actions to fund managers.

Managed corporate action events and researched fair market values when required.

Recognized for achieving high accuracy standards and received client appreciation.

Education

MBA/PGDM | Finance Symbiosis Centre for Distance Learning (SCDL)

B.B.A/ B.M.S - Bachelor of Business Admin / Mgmt Studies | Management Deogiri College, Aurangabad Marks - 86%

12th Maharashtra, English Marks - 83%

10th CBSE, English Marks - 76%

Extra-curricular activities

Knowledge Sharing

Conducted training and knowledge assessments for new and existing team members to improve team capability and process adherence.

Achievements

Operational Accuracy

Consistently maintained high accuracy in pricing and reconciliation activities with client appreciation and recognition for quality.

Additional information

Hobbies: Technical Blogging, Financial Modelling, Running

Languages: English, Hindi, Marathi
